title: Concept: Authorization enforced with assert in python — review required
description: In python, an access decision is expressed as an assert. Under the optimised interpreter every assert is compiled away, so the authorization branch silently vanishes and the request proceeds as the authenticated principal. The same statement looks correct in development, which is why the failure only appears in the deployment that matters.
applicability: python request handlers and service functions; lexical scope.
risk: Authorization bypass in optimised deployments; MEDIUM severity.
